events.title: 노팅엄 포리스트 pay 리즈 유나이티드 £650,000 for Republic of Ireland midfielder John Sheridan .
에버턴 sign 애스턴 빌라 defender 마틴 키온 for £750,000.
리버풀 beat 아스널 1–0 in the Charity Shield at Wembley. Peter Beardsley scores the only goal of the game.
Adrian Heath returns to English football after less than a year in Spain when he joins 애스턴 빌라 from 에스파뇰 for £360,000.
Property tycoon Michael Knighton agrees to buy control of 맨체스터 유나이티드 in a deal which is believed to be worth around £20 million.

On the first day of the First Division season, champions 아스널 lose 4–1 away to 맨체스터 유나이티드, while 리버풀 beat 맨체스터 시티 3–1. Second Division promotion favourites 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 and 리즈 유나이티드 clash at St James' Park in a match which ends with the home side winning 5–2, with Micky Quinn scoring four goals on his 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 debut. In the Second Division, Frank McAvennie breaks his leg in 웨스트햄 유나이티드's 1–1 draw at Stoke and is expected to be out of action until at least the winter.
루턴 타운 pay a club record £650,000 for striker Lars Elstrup from Danish side OB Odense .
토트넘 홋스퍼 sign defender Pat van den Hauwe from 에버턴 for £650,000.
Paul Bracewell , who has missed most of the last three years because of injury, joins 선덜랜드 for £250,000.
웨스트햄 유나이티드 boost their Second Division promotion push with a £675,000 move for 퀸스 파크 레인저스 midfielder Martin Allen , just weeks after a move to First Division champions 아스널 collapsed.

Newly promoted 첼시 go top of the First Division after three games with a 4–0 home win over 셰필드 웬즈데이. 더비 카운티 beat 맨체스터 유나이티드 2–0 at the Baseball Ground. A Second Division encounter at Dean Court sees 본머스 beat 헐 시티 5–4.
게리 팰리스터 becomes Britain's most expensive defender in a £2.3 million move from 미들즈브러 to 맨체스터 유나이티드.
맨체스터 유나이티드 suffer another disappointing First Division result, losing 2–0 at home to 노리치 시티. 코번트리 시티 go top of the First Division with a 2–1 home win over 맨체스터 시티.

The first month of the league season ends with 코번트리 시티 as First Division leaders after three wins from four games. 셰필드 웬즈데이 prop up the table, followed by newly promoted 맨체스터 시티 and 크리스털 팰리스. Defending champions 아스널 occupy a lowly 15th place. In the Second Division, 웨스트햄 유나이티드 lead the table, level on points with 블랙번 로버스 . The play-off places are occupied by 셰필드 유나이티드 (newly promoted), 입스위치 타운 , 왓퍼드 and newly relegated 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 .
